I have resolved the issue in [django/db/models/fields/json.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-v2t_ghw6/django/db/models/fields/json.py):

- Added [`HasKeyLookup.compile_json_path_final_key`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-v2t_ghw6/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L175-L177) so that the final key in [`HasKeyLookup.as_sql`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-v2t_ghw6/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L179-L208) is always compiled as a JSON object key (`.%s` via `json.dumps()`) rather than an array index (`[%s]`) on SQLite, MySQL, and Oracle.
- Implemented [`HasKeyLookup.get_prep_lookup`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-v2t_ghw6/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L235-L241) to convert non-[`KeyTransform`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-v2t_ghw6/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L315-L369) lookup values to strings across `has_key`, `has_keys`, and `has_any_keys`.
- Added [`HasKeyOrArrayIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-v2t_ghw6/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L262-L264) for [`KeyTransformIsNull`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-v2t_ghw6/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L398-L419) and [`KeyTransformExact`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-v2t_ghw6/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L451-L488) to preserve array index support in key/index transforms.
